title: British population comparison
description: Compares a sample's variant calls with British (GBR) and global 1000 Genomes allele frequencies, and lists the variants that are rare in British people or differ most from other populations. Research demonstration only.

vcf.title: Annotated VCF
vcf.description: variants/<sample>.annotated.vcf.gz from a run of the 1000 Genomes British (GBR) germline demo.

max_af.title: Rare variant threshold
max_af.description: Variants with a British allele frequency below this are listed as rare. 0.01 is 1%.
